note: Eased Thursday: Hard cards first (15 EN + 8 YUE), then only 6 new STAR #2 Result / 'so that' lines. Say it out loud, the owl is listening. 先复习，再开口。

tasks.prompt: Say ×3 each: 'in spring and winter' (no *the*) and 'regression' (ri-GRESH-un). Then STAR #2 full S-T-A-R in one take (~90 s): buffer question → your job → season/MTR pattern + took the initiative → 'As a result, the team narrowed the distance buffer… which made the model more focused…'.
